summary: Add a jump host through inventory, group or host variables: ansible_user, ansible_connection: ssh and ansible_ssh_common_args with `-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q user@jump_server"`.
questions: How do I set a jump host with inventory variables?
Bastion host per group automation controller

answer_card.title: Jump host via inventory variables
answer_card.answer_md:
At inventory, group or host level:
```yaml
ansible_user: <user_name>
ansible_connection: ssh
ansible_ssh_common_args: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q <user_name>@<jump_server_name>"'
```
